findings: NATIVE-1: layout threaded_reflow::paragraph_break missed a break sentinel preceded by a glyph-less marker (index marker, or any unresolved marker): the following text stayed in the frame and no BreakOutcome was reported. Found by the native-Type host test, fixed in 8a7bbf8d (threaded_reflow.rs is outside this lane's owned paths: waiver requested below)

NATIVE-2: Type refuses a paragraph holding U+2028 (forced line break) with MissingGlyph: the engine shapes U+2028 as content and the Inter fixture maps no glyph to it. STU-TYP-207 stores the forced line break as U+2028, so native composition of a forced line break fails today. Proposal for a type lane: keep U+2028 outside the shaping buffer like the paragraph separators and let layout break the line there (layout's UAX #14 already treats it as mandatory)
